## What's new in v2.0.46

### Installer: running it now always switches back to UniWRT
If you had tried another theme, running the install line again only refreshed UniWRT's files and left LuCI on the other theme, so it looked like nothing had happened.

Running the installer now always makes UniWRT the active theme, and says which theme it switched from. To update UniWRT without switching (for example, if you keep it installed but use another theme day to day), add `--keep-theme`:

```sh
sh /tmp/uniwrt-apply.sh --keep-theme
```

Package upgrades through `apk`/`opkg` are unchanged: they keep whatever theme you have chosen.

### Upgrading
Run the install line below again, then reload the page.
